Image Emboss Filter

Apply a real 3×3 emboss convolution kernel for a raised, carved look.

🖼️ Drop an image here or click to browse

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an image into the tool.
  2. The embossed version appears instantly.
  3. Click Download PNG to save it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the emboss effect computed?

A 3×3 emboss kernel ([-2,-1,0],[-1,1,1],[0,1,2]) with a 128 grey offset, computed pixel by pixel.

Does it work on any photo?

Yes — embossing works best on photos with clear shapes and good contrast.

What format is the download?

A lossless PNG at the original dimensions.
